selection: Selected from the official inventory for its non-coding web tasks and small complete groups, before downloading or inspecting outcomes. The public binary item-level release contains 233 items and 33 subject configurations. Inventory slug real and release directory real_webagents share OpenReview paper Un1sWxmZuI.
comparison: Fixed Beta(1,1) versus empirical mean, with constant 0.5 as a reference. No fitting or tuning.
eligibility: Include every subject group with at least 80 distinct observed items. All groups have at most 233 source items. Report missing grades, excluded small groups, repeated outcomes and infeasible guarded pools without changing selection based on scores.
endpoint: Mean paired Brier ALC difference, Beta(1,1) minus empirical mean, equally weighted over eligible subject groups and the three fixed acquisition seeds.
diagnostics: All budgets, seed deltas, group wins/losses, lexical split sensitivity, and exact acquisition expectation conditional on the saved pools. Report observed and expected scores separately.
interpretation: One new public benchmark evaluated after the coding and BertaQA studies. Group size can fit the official draw but does not reproduce its balancing procedure or private data. No benchmark-level confidence interval or generalization guarantee.
